findings.title: Possible SQL Injection in User Login Handler
findings.description: User input directly formatted into raw SQL query without parameterized cursor execution.

metadata.fix_recommendation: Use parameterized queries or ORM models instead of string concatenation.

findings.title: Hardcoded JWT Secret Key
findings.description: Hardcoded secret key string detected in source code.

metadata.fix_recommendation: Store secrets in environment variables or a secure key management vault.
